clauses.quote: The District shall make reasonable efforts to keep all school grounds and facilities free of unwanted rodents, pests, and insects such as ants, roaches, and fleas.
Insecticides/poisons utilized on District property shall only occur in strict compliance with applicable laws.
Site administrators at sites with traveling teachers shall consult with teachers involved
clauses.subject_text: Site administrators at sites with traveling teachers

clauses.quote: Site administrators at sites with traveling teachers shall develop a plan for assigning traveling teachers on a fair and equitable basis.
clauses.subject_text: Site administrators at sites with traveling teachers

clauses.quote: On-site teachers shall not be given a traveling teacher assignment if a physician verifies in writing that a reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act is recommended or that the teacher's health would be detrimentally affected.
clauses.notes: Conditional exemption from traveling assignment based on ADA or health.

clauses.quote: In either case, the physician shall provide the projected period of time that such assignment shall not be given.
clauses.notes: Physician's procedural duty to specify accommodation duration.
